name: eMudhra

snapshot.about: eMudhra provides identity, trust, cybersecurity platforms, digital signature solutions, and certificate lifecycle management.

narrative: Management met its FY26 revenue guidance of ₹700 crore by achieving ₹702 crore and met EBITDA margin guidance at 23.0%. However, FY26 PAT margin of 15.4% slightly missed the guided range of 15.5% to 16.0%.

promises.statement: Management expects FY26 PAT margin to be between 15.5% and 16%.

said.quote: More than EBITDA margin, the PAT only, we are thinking of around that same 16%, 15.5% to 16%, what I guided earlier

actual_source.quote: We closed the year with a total income of INR7,132 million, up 35% year-on-year

promises.note: FY26 PAT margin was 15.4%, missing guided range of 15.5% to 16.0%.

promises.statement: Management expects to maintain 25% to 30% overall revenue growth compared to last year.
